breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification completely avoids using the ideal-gas law for liquid water. Instead, it directly specifies the correct liquid water density of 998 kg/m³ at 20°C, which matches the ground truth approach of treating water as incompressible with ρ ≈ 998 kg/m³. The Bernoulli equation is then applied with this correct density.
